note: MLflow 3.x unified lifecycle: tracking, evaluation (traditional ML & GenAI), observability, versioning, governance on Databricks + Unity Catalog.

children.note: Experiment organization, run parameter/metric/artifact logging, run comparison in notebook UI.
Web interface for managing experiments, comparing runs, viewing metrics and artifacts.
Automatic parameter and metric capture for scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow, PyTorch, LightGBM frameworks.
First-class logging for parameters, metrics, artifacts, models, and code versions within runs.
Models as distinct entities with versioning, signatures, metrics, parameters, traces, and lineage across development/staging/prod.
Built-in LLM judges (correctness, completeness, fluency, safety, relevance, RAG groundedness) + custom LLM/code-based scorers; human feedback loops.
Automatic capture of upstream Unity Catalog datasets, feature dependencies, model versions, and deployment tracking via MLflow input logging.

note: End-to-end automated ML: data prep, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, glass-box generated notebooks. Classification, regression, forecasting (serverless preview).

children.note: Binary & multiclass prediction via decision trees, random forests, logistic regression, XGBoost, LightGBM.
Continuous value prediction via trees, linear regression, XGBoost, LightGBM with automated hyperparameter tuning.
Classic compute: Prophet, Auto-ARIMA. Serverless (PuP): Prophet, Auto-ARIMA, DeepAR on managed GPU infrastructure.
Inspectable trial notebooks for data exploration, preprocessing, model training, evaluation, SHAP explainability; reproducible and editable.
Automated feature importance and impact analysis via SHAP for classification/regression; can be disabled to reduce memory overhead.
Programmatic interface (`databricks.automl.classify/regress/forecast`) with configuration options for columns, metrics, stopping conditions.

note: Multi-GPU and multi-node training: ML Runtime, AI Runtime (serverless GPU), Ray Train, TorchDistributor, DeepSpeed, Spark MLlib, Ray Tune hyperparameter optimization.
since: ML Runtime GA (2019); AI Runtime PuP (June 2026); Ray/TorchDistributor GA (2023)

children.note: Pre-installed ML libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, TensorFlow-legacy, MLflow); GPU drivers; Spark MLlib support.
Managed serverless GPU (A10/H100); notebook `@distributed` API for single-node DDP/FSDP/DeepSpeed; no cluster management.
Framework-agnostic distributed training orchestration; multi-GPU/multi-node PyTorch, TensorFlow; Ray Data & Ray Tune integration.
Launcher for distributed PyTorch via Spark cluster resources; wraps `torch.distributed.run`; minimal migration from existing DDP code.
Distributed classification, regression, clustering, recommendations; pipeline APIs (pyspark.ml) for scalable ML on massive datasets.
Memory & scale optimization: ZeRO sharding, optimizer/gradient partitioning, CPU offload; via TorchDistributor on classic compute or AI Runtime.
Parallel hyperparameter trials with Ray Tune; integrates with Ray Train for distributed trials; Optuna support for custom optimization.
